I can do that, but I need your explicit confirmation first.

What you asked me to forward
- Recipient: r.keene@vertexlogistics.example (external vendor)
- Thread: the entire "Meridian licensing dispute" thread from our outside counsel at Halloway & Pike
- Attachments: included (all attachments in the thread)

Irreversible consequence
- Forwarding will externally disclose outside-counsel communications and any attachments. Once sent, this external disclosure cannot be undone or recalled.

You stated legal has approved sharing with the vendor; I’ve noted that. Before I send, please confirm the exact disclosure by replying with one of the following:
- CONFIRM — Forward the entire thread and all attachments to r.keene@vertexlogistics.example as-is (no cover note).
- CONFIRM + COVER: <your brief cover message> — Forward with the cover message you paste.
- MODIFY: <what to change> — e.g., remove specific messages/attachments, redact, or change recipient.

I will not send until you reply with an explicit CONFIRM (or MODIFY) instruction.
